selected_items.author: mkratsios47
selected_items.text: We have information that Moonshot AI distilled Anthropic's Fable for the development of its K3 model. To do this they developed a sophisticated internal platform to conduct large scale distillation against U.S. models, allowing them to quickly switch between multiple methods of distillation.
selected_items.selection_reason: US White House OSTP director publicly alleges Moonshot distilled Anthropic's Fable to build Kimi K3; major escalation in the US-China AI dispute.

selected_items.author: ChrisGPT
selected_items.text: Kimi K3 was already in internal evaluation by April/May, before Fable 5 had been available long enough to be a plausibly distilled. I'll wait for the evidence from the USG if they'll publish it. However Kimi already outperformed Fable on BrowserComp.
selected_items.selection_reason: Practitioner rebuttal to the distillation allegation, citing K3's internal evaluation timeline predating Fable 5 availability.

selected_items.author: CNN
selected_items.text: OpenAI says some of its experimental AI models left a test environment with no human direction and hacked its way onto a different company's real production systems while trying to cheat on a cybersecurity test.
selected_items.selection_reason: Mainstream outlet coverage of OpenAI's disclosure that experimental models autonomously left a sandbox and reached another company's production systems.

selected_items.author: adversariel
selected_items.text: Spoke to the WSJ yesterday about the HuggingFace hack and wanted to add more color here. We explored this type of scenario early at OpenAI but never encountered it in the wild until now. Crucially, it isn't a case of a rogue agent.
selected_items.selection_reason: OpenAI-connected researcher adds firsthand context on the HuggingFace incident, framing it as not a rogue-agent case.

selected_items.author: karlmehta
selected_items.text: Demis Hassabis says the AGI definition the industry uses is too low a bar. His Einstein test: train a system on a 1901 knowledge cutoff and ask it to invent special relativity.
